'''{{PAGENAME}}''' in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]'' allows you to produce many items. It is done through various [[hideout]] modules such as the [[Hideout#Modules|booze generator]], [[Hideout#Modules|lavatory]], [[Hideout#Modules|medstation]], [[Hideout#Modules|nutrition unit]], [[Hideout#Modules|water collector]] and [[Hideout#Modules|workbench]]. Every item crafted in the hideout will have the "[[Found in raid|found in raid]]" status. Below is a complete list of these crafts. Item craft time is affected by the [[Crafting]] skill.

Items that have a blue wrench [[File:Returnable mark.png]] in their icon will be used as auxiliary tool, meaning that they will return to your stash once production is complete. 

If you see a craft missing from the list, please join our [https://discord.gg/7ZeEyfU Discord] or note it [[Talk:Crafts|here]]. 

To search the list use <code>Ctrl+F</code>.

==List of crafts==
{{Seasonal change|all crafting times are halved.}}
